name: Barracuda RSO Bar – Milk Chocolate
description: Barracuda Milk Chocolate Bars are crafted from the highest-quality ingredients. The chocolate is made of 65% Belgian chocolate combined with the purest distillate from our very own Michigan-made Cannalicious Labs for the smoothest consumption experience to date. Infused with RSO, one of the most versatile and lauded cannabis innovations that contains all the cannabinoids, terpenes and beneficial compounds from the entire cannabis plant. Each bar contains 200mg THC and RSO for a full-spectrum experience and fully activates in 1-2 hours.
